title: Global Anthem Atlas: themes, Energy and Wisdom indices for the lyrics of national anthems and national songs
description:
Lyrics-based theme profiles for 242 national anthems and national songs (254 songs listed across 219 countries and regions). Each song has 12 theme scores, two descriptive indices with 90% uncertainty intervals (Energy = Mobilisation + Awakening; Wisdom = justice/peace, truth/virtue, future), per-country spectra, and the reproducible pipeline plus the interactive site.

Energy and Wisdom describe what the words of a song talk about, not countries or peoples; no ranking of nations is supported.

Texts. This GitHub archive and site do not include withheld lyrics or the raw in-copyright lyric table. Lyrics and translations appear in the public package only where rights allow; other texts can be rehydrated from pinned public sources.
